maturityDefinitions.planned: A governed target or decision exists, but no usable implementation is proven.
maturityDefinitions.read-only: A live read path is implemented, but mutation or end-to-end operation is not proven.
maturityDefinitions.dry-run: The system can validate or plan without committing the durable operation.
maturityDefinitions.executable: The operation has an implementation path, but required real-process evidence is incomplete.
maturityDefinitions.validated: Row-specific real-process evidence proves the required cross-repository path and platforms.
maturityDefinitions.excluded: A recorded Release 1 product decision makes the capability unavailable and forbids a GA claim.
